label: MEASURED

bound.fault_model: single-cycle bit flip of any gate output or flop Q

note: BOUNDED, NOT UNBOUNDED: verdict holds only for <= 1 single-cycle bit-flip faults (gate outputs and flop Q) within 8 cycles on this synthesized netlist. It says nothing about more faults, longer runs, other fault types (stuck-at, multi-bit/spatial, clock/voltage effects), or physical feasibility. Toy design; modelled faults.

explanation.summary: SINGLE POINT OF FAILURE: one OR gate output, net `$abc$206$new_n21_`, combines 8 input bits of `sig` (the redundant checks converge here) and alone drives 8 of 8 bits of `boot_word`. Flipping it for ONE cycle (cycle 2) makes a wrong `sig` look valid, even though the checks upstream are duplicated.
explanation.fix_pattern: Do not let any one net decide. Split the decision across independent bits: give each redundant check its own disjoint group of result-word bits (no shared AND/OR of the checks), use a sparse result encoding with Hamming distance > fault budget, and make the final accept require all groups to agree bit-by-bit.
